fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The USA Pluto Return Takes Center Stage", "body": "Kayleigh said Pluto would return to its 1776 position of 27 degrees and 33 minutes Capricorn on February 20, 2022, with three exact hits over the year. She described Capricorn as the sign of established structures and argued that the decay visible since 2008 would turn into a transformation of those structures in the United States. To test the idea, she looked at Pluto returns in England, citing a famine, Elizabeth I's religious laws and the early nineteenth century, and concluded that other nations came through theirs just fine."}, {"title": "Neptune Opposition and the Great Splitting", "body": "Looking at a biwheel of the US birth chart with the current transits, Kayleigh pointed to a thick Neptune opposition and a Neptune square to the natal Mars. She said Neptune could bring unconditional love and mysticism or delusion, addiction and fog, and she described Neptune in the third house as a spell over national communications. Chance offered his own reading that half the country might sink into addiction while the other half expanded spiritually, and the pair agreed that it illustrated the great splitting they were already seeing."}, {"title": "Jupiter in Pisces and the 1856 Echo", "body": "Kayleigh said Jupiter would meet Neptune in Pisces on April 9 and enter Aries on May 10, and she framed Pisces as a place of both depression and spiritual insight. To see what might follow, she researched 1856, the last Jupiter and Neptune conjunction in Pisces, and listed shipwrecks, the Paris maritime declaration, the Know Nothings, new universities and the founding of Credit Suisse. Chance added his own suspicion about how grand early university buildings appeared in tiny towns, pointing to Columbia, Missouri. Kayleigh said she would not be surprised by flooding or a burst of artwork, and the talk turned to hopes that court cases would resolve well."}, {"title": "The Nodes Move to Taurus and Scorpio", "body": "Kayleigh said the lunar nodes were shifting from Gemini and Sagittarius to Taurus and Scorpio, moving from an axis of perception to an axis of resources. She described Taurus as earth, survival and real food, and Scorpio as shared resources, transformation and consequences. She predicted guerrilla gardening, regenerative agriculture and food forests, and said Saturn in Aquarius squaring the nodes would bring delays and controls. Chance wondered whether Uranus in Taurus could point toward tapping the ambient electricity of the earth, linking it to his recent conversation with George Wiseman."}, {"title": "Pluto in Scorpio, Shadow Work, and Grounding", "body": "Kayleigh, a Pluto in Scorpio native, said her generation faced a south node transit over Pluto while Uranus opposed it, which she called a chance for huge karmic release, with fruition for some and evolution for others. She warned that old debts and buried secrets could surface. Throughout the night she urged listeners to ground, stay in their bodies and keep up their spiritual hygiene, and she insisted that shadow work is never finished. She closed with a short lesson on finding a transit in your own birth chart."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The brilliant astrologer and avid member of the InnerVerse Telegram group, Kayleigh Berkana, joins Vibe Rant tonight to go over the major movements in the heavens for the upcoming year. Kayleigh's a Capricorn so she's totally in her zone right now. Expect a fun and informative (infunative?) Rant!
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "But I'm thinking like half of the country is going to be going deeper into addiction and mental slavery and psychic death, psychic suicide. I think that's easier to do than the way we're doing it now.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "52 InnerVerse episodes, which would be one for each week. I have a Capricorn ascendant, a Capricorn north node, a Capricorn moon. If I could control my life, I would. The beautiful expressions include unconditional love, forgiveness, mysticism. Beautiful things like that. The dark side of Neptune is delusion and addiction and spells, fog, awful shit like that.", "author": "Kayleigh Berkana", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/5c923247-58f8-42f0-a64e-59357e5336f4/KAYLEIGH-BERKANA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Wherever Jupiter goes, he expands things. But also like spiritual insight, intuition, you know, the mystic abilities, all those things live there.", "author": "Kayleigh Berkana", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/5c923247-58f8-42f0-a64e-59357e5336f4/KAYLEIGH-BERKANA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Taurus is all about the earth.
